headline: EPS more than triples year-over-year
summary_short: Bridgestone reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥90.93, up 207.9% y/y from ¥29.53.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥90.93 more than tripled year-over-year, up 207.9% from ¥29.53, and rose a further 25.6% sequentially from ¥72.37 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
